title: Poster Session
text:
The poster session runs 4:30 – 6:30 in CGIS Knafel, Fisher Family Commons, with a happy hour (drinks and pizza).
We currently have about 10 confirmed posters and may have up to 20. Many attendees have indicated they are willing to discuss a paper in the poster session. We will match discussants once the poster lineup is finalized.

title: About
text: The Democracy and Political Violence Conference & Working Group convenes researchers working on political violence and (anti-)democratic attitudes. Our first conference will be held at Harvard University in Cambridge, MA before APSA 2026.

title: About
text:
Organizers
The conference is organized by Sam Fuller, Gal Bitton, and Jack T. Rametta.

title: About
text:
Sponsors

title: Democracy and Political ViolenceConference & Working Group
text:
About the conference
The Democracy and Political Violence APSA 2026 Pre-Conference brings together researchers studying political violence and (anti-)democratic attitudes across comparative and national contexts. The day features three main panels, a poster session, and structured opportunities to connect researchers.
Organized by Sam Fuller, Gal Bitton, and Jack T. Rametta.
